game_concept: A card battler set in Eldritch Ruins – Glyph Corridor, a corridor of glyphs: the relic hunter must handle cursed statues while practicing lists. Core idea – Duplicate Sweep: Remove repeated items from a list of chalk marks while keeping the order.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Glyph Corridor: a corridor of glyphs
core_gameplay_loop: In Glyph Corridor, repeat each round: Remove repeated items from a list of chalk marks while keeping the order. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the clean_list value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 13 consecutive correct decisions about clean_list to power up the relic hunter and open the spirit lantern.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 8 (extended tier): Duplicate Sweep
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Duplicate Sweep' (Week 7 slot 12), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Glyph Corridor'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
